findings.title: Evidence DTO clobbers launch plan before required schedules; terminal recovery loses local facts and persistence diagnostics

counterexamples.trigger: Successful early work and coordination, then first timeout phase
counterexamples.expected: Original closed launch plan reaches all real schedules
counterexamples.actual: Coordination evidence replaces document; NativeCustodySession.start raises CustodyError CUSTODY_PLAN_KEY_SET_INVALID before read schedule

counterexamples.trigger: Early assertion plus failed local terminal write followed by successful outer recovery
counterexamples.expected: Full observed facts, explicit identity, persistence diagnostics, original and additional failures survive bounded recovery
counterexamples.actual: Recovery reads unrelated r10_raw; local raw/api/error facts disappear from recovered barrier/final phase

counterexamples.trigger: Earlier assertion fails with clean cleanup; or earlier final evidence write fails
counterexamples.expected: Final earlier operation FAIL when original failed; preserve each evidence error in recovery
counterexamples.actual: early verdict ignores original_failure and can be PASSED; final-write errors appended after snapshot are not exported and can disappear

counterexamples.trigger: Original failure unwinds and a recovery/NOT_RUN write fails
counterexamples.expected: Original rethrows plus durable complete inventory with persistence diagnostic
counterexamples.actual: Write-error list remains local; final assertions unreachable on original unwind and missing terminal is not durably accounted

findings.title: Exact cancellation precedence and best-effort all-owner cleanup remain incomplete

counterexamples.trigger: Seam barrier evidence write raises exact KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit K with no earlier test failure
counterexamples.expected: All cleanup then exact K before ordinary evidence assertion
counterexamples.actual: K retained but later AssertionError becomes original_failure and suppresses K rethrow

counterexamples.trigger: Cleanup retains K1 then cleanup evidence write raises distinct K2 without original unwind
counterexamples.expected: First exact cleanup interruption K1 rethrown after cleanup
counterexamples.actual: Current writer cancellation K2 raised before earlier pending list is checked

counterexamples.trigger: First unguarded caller gate release interrupted, including while another original failure unwinds
counterexamples.expected: Record exact interruption, attempt next gate/endpoints/stop/drain/evidence, original unwind has priority
counterexamples.actual: Finally exits before guarded drain and skips later cleanup; original can be replaced

counterexamples.trigger: First entries enumeration fails while registry already contains exact observed child/other thread refs
counterexamples.expected: Independent exact-reference fallback still attempts every observed owner
counterexamples.actual: entries becomes empty and observed derives from same empty list; first drain fallback is empty and partial-child refs absent
